youtube.title: Who Was Shri Ram? The 16 Qualities | Ramayana Ep 2
youtube.description:
One question. Sixteen qualities. And only one man alive who had them all. 🏹

Before the Krauncha birds and the first shloka, Maharishi Valmiki asked the sage Narada: is there anyone in this world who is virtuous, mighty, truthful, firm in his vows, kind to every being, who has conquered anger, and whom even the gods fear in battle? Narada's answer: Rama, born in the line of Ikshvaku.

📜 The question (Valmiki Ramayana 1.1.2):
"Ko nvasmin sāmprataṁ loke guṇavān kaśca vīryavān, dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca satyavākyo dṛḍhavrataḥ"

One question. Sixteen qualities. Only one man.

Before the Ramayana was written, Maharishi Valmiki asked the sage Narada:
is anyone alive truthful, firm in his vows, kind to every being, master of his anger,
yet feared even by the gods in battle?
Narada's answer: Rama of the Ikshvaku line.
